purpose: What the GAME says is unlockable, against what the catalogue ships. Generated locally beside the catalogue, committed, and checked in CI by data/validate-coverage.mjs with no game installation. Every row the catalogue does not cover is classified recommended / excluded / undecided by data/coverage-policy.mjs.

reasons.channel:action: combat action granted by a job quest; the game announces it itself on level-up
reasons.channel:aether-current-set: the per-zone aggregate of the aether-current rows; listing it as well would count the same unlock twice
reasons.channel:craft-action: crafting action from a class quest; same reason as action
reasons.channel:dye-slot: per-item dye condition, not a player-facing unlock
reasons.channel:emj-costume: internal costume rows, no player-facing name
reasons.channel:fate: a FATE is world content, not something you unlock and keep
reasons.channel:flight: per-zone flight is the same unlock as that zone's aether current set, which the catalogue already lists
reasons.channel:general-action: general action already covered by the catalogue's own system entries
reasons.channel:occult-note: internal Occult Crescent note rows, no player-facing name
reasons.channel:trait: passive job trait; same reason as action
reasons.duty-granularity:Deep Dungeons: the catalogue lists the dungeon and the game lists its floor bands; same open question as Raids
reasons.duty-granularity:Raids: the catalogue lists the raid TIER and the game lists the per-floor duty row; which granularity the checklist wants is an open UI decision
reasons.duty-kind:: duty kind the catalogue does not list (ContentType '(none)'): tutorial and unnamed rows such as "Avoid Area of Effect Attacks"
reasons.duty-kind:Gold Saucer: duty kind the catalogue does not list (ContentType 'Gold Saucer'): chocobo-race courses and GATEs, not level-gated unlocks
reasons.duty-kind:PvP: duty kind the catalogue does not list (ContentType 'PvP'): individual arenas; the catalogue lists PvP as one system entry
reasons.duty-kind:Quest Battles: duty kind the catalogue does not list (ContentType 'Quest Battles'): MSQ solo instances, not separate unlocks
reasons.duty-kind:The Masked Carnivale: duty kind the catalogue does not list (ContentType 'The Masked Carnivale'): individual acts of one system the catalogue lists once
reasons.duty-kind:Treasure Hunt: duty kind the catalogue does not list (ContentType 'Treasure Hunt'): map dungeons reached from an item, not a level-gated unlock
reasons.duty:retired: retired: not in the duty finder and the game names no unlock quest
reasons.granularity:aether-current: the catalogue lists one entry per ZONE (30 of them) and the game has 151 individual currents. Collecting a zone's currents is one thing a player sets out to do; 151 pickup rows is not a checklist anybody wants. Per-current granularity is deliberately not proposed — but the ratio is exactly why this artefact exists, so it is reported rather than hidden.
reasons.row:dead-gate: the gate quest names a row that is absent from the live sheet — unreleased or removed content
reasons.row:seasonal: the gate quest belongs to a seasonal event (Quest.Festival is set), so it is real but not obtainable today; showing it as available in a level checklist would be a lie. Ships only behind a seasonal status the gate calculator can map to "not right now"
reasons.triple-triad-card:npc-match-prerequisite: TripleTriadCardResident.Quest names the NPC-match prerequisite, not a quest that awards the card; only the cards that arrive through an ItemAction are genuine quest rewards
reasons.allowance:label-names-no-game-row: the entry's label shape names something no sheet holds, so the generator declined to guess an identity and there is nothing to look up
reasons.allowance:system-features-have-no-game-r: the game keeps no row for this feature anywhere; there is no general system-unlock table to enumerate against, so systems stay curated
